about: The montage source list: every free or open-licence site KOSIF draws footage, photos, VFX, textures, music, sound effects and graphics from, one record per site with its licence, commercial use and credit rule. Read by scripts/free_media_catalog.py (list, find, show, check). The searchable subset lives in data/free_footage_sources.json (video) and scripts/free_photos.py (photos); data/media_sources_100.json is the download gateway's domain list. 'tools' names which of those already cover a site.
reachability_note: reach was measured on checked_on from a claude.ai cloud sandbox behind its agent proxy (one GET each): ok, blocked-from-cloud (401/403/429/503, usually a bot wall that a home browser passes), timeout, or no-dns (the domain did not resolve: the site may be gone). Re-measure with scripts/free_media_catalog.py probe.
notice: A listed site is not a licence for any file. 'commercial' and 'credit' summarise each site's published terms as of checked_on and were not re-read per file: per-item means read the file's own page. Free tiers change; before paid or monetised work open the licence link. ND and non-commercial licences do not fit monetised montage.
